content.title: Did Jesus Exist? The Historical Argument for Jesus of Nazareth
content.author: Bart D. Ehrman (New York: HarperOne, 2012)
content.note: An agnostic New Testament historian's case that Jesus existed, written against the mythicist view: the independent Gospel sources, Paul's acquaintance with Peter and James, and the Aramaic traditions behind the Gospels.
